rng_initialization.scope: CPU construction for all three seeds and four arms at 11 probe sites; same site-independent shared parameter architecture. No optimizer/backward/training call.

source_drop_threshold.interpretation: not_estimated_gate_disabled describes arm-local non-use; it does not mean no threshold was computed anywhere in the fold.

limitations: No new training, no optimizer/backward; budget evidence comes from recorded per-city counts plus identical inspected training implementation; checkpoints contain no optimizer/RNG snapshots.
No same-run Full control was retrained. Paired evaluation alignment does not establish bitwise same training trajectory across different run times.

Gate flags/relation mode are Python attributes rather than state_dict tensors; evidence combines checkpoint metadata, manifest, runner constructor and strict state load. Saved predictions were checked in full; checkpoint-to-prediction full inference replay was not performed.
Source-drop metadata null means no applied source envelope. Shared source threshold was estimated once for other arms; cannot claim no threshold computation in the entire fold.
New training lacks per-fold environment snapshots and complete transitive import hashes; audit-time versions/imports are captured now, not reconstructed training-time attestation.
Current frozen protocol and code hashes match recorded canonical/manifest hashes where recorded; unrecorded historical dependencies cannot be certified.
